description: This file defines the STTService class, which manages real-time speech-to-text transcription using OpenAI's API. It handles audio capture, voice activity detection, and transcription event processing, coordinating multiple services to provide low-latency streaming transcription.

classes.name: STTService
classes.description: Manages real-time speech-to-text transcription, coordinating audio capture, voice activity detection, and communication with OpenAI's Whisper API, providing streaming transcription with event handling and error recovery.

methods.name: setMicrophoneDevice
methods.description: Sets the microphone device for audio capture.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a new transcription session with specified configuration and language.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the current transcription session, finalizing and returning the transcribed text.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the ongoing transcription session and cleans up resources.

methods.name: isRecording
methods.description: Indicates whether a transcription session is active.
